demo_route.source: Lady Bug program ROMs l1.c4 through l6.k4

colour_configuration.description: Foreground palette indices for shared text. Static overrides use screen, x, y, width and colour. Omitted cells retain the authored compiler mapping. Zero is allowed for static text; dynamic descriptor colours are 1..15 because zero identifies graphics. Named field_runs resolve the actual authored digit cells inside Tiled score rectangles; blank score padding is not coloured.

shared_text.encoding: Static RLE: count, graphic ID below174; or count,174+glyph,colour. Dynamic IDs index typed descriptors; colour0 selects graphics.
